en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,
‘Every Fast can be separated except for the three days regarding an expiation for the oath’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘ Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
All fasts can lawfully be completed in different times except the fast which is as expiation for an oath.”’
